description: This file contains functions for migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying migrations within an OpenWRT system configuration. It defines functions to update sysfs paths for LEDs, handle exceptions, and commit configuration changes.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates sysfs paths for LEDs based on provided mappings and logs the changes.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes device name prefix from sysfs paths unless exceptions are specified, and logs the change.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies LED sysfs migration for all entries.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes from LEDs paths for all entries.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Applies any pending configuration changes in a specified realm (configuration section).
